messages:
meera: Quick ask from Acme procurement 3 they need a secure upload for SOC2 + ISO artifacts and a signed pentest attestation. Want 72h SFTP creds and a receipt confirmation.

sam: We can do SFTP into evidence-bucket, folder-scoped, 72h TTL. Need filenames + uploader email + whether files contain customer PII. Also ask for source IPs for allowlist.

alice@acmecorp.com: Files: soc2-2025.pdf, iso_scope.docx, pentest_attest_signed.pdf. No PII. We'll upload tomorrow 08:30 UTC. IPs: 34.201.22.0/24 (vpn).

katie: Creating user `acme_poc_1798`. Key will be DM'd via 2FA link. SFTP path: sftp://evidence.redwood.ai/acme_poc_1798/. TTL set to 72h (expiry 2025-03-08T08:30Z). Ill enable server-side encryption and logging.

eli: Note: hosted POC 3 avoid internal-only diagrams. If network diagrams include internal ranges, request redaction first.

sam: Ack on pentest letter: legal requires vendor name, signer, and date visible. If scanned, ensure legibility. We'll compute SHA256 after upload and return checksums.

sec-bot: Auto-scan queued: secret detection + malware scan. Results will be posted here.

katie: Please include readme.txt in the upload with uploader name + UTC timestamp to simplify verification.

alice@acmecorp.com: Got it. We'll include readme.txt and start upload at 08:30 UTC. Who to ping if transfer fails?

meera: Ping me + sam. I'll be on the 09:00 POC sync.

sam: After upload we will post: received files list, SHA256 hashes, retention window (30 days default), and next steps if scan flags anything.

sec-bot: Scan complete: no high-risk findings; one low-risk token (internal hostname) flagged. Security will review.

meera: Thanks all. Once hashes are posted I'll send formal acknowledgement to Acme. Target close: 2025-03-10 EOD. :thumbsup:
